question: What legal disclosures are required when selling FSBO in Florida?
answer: Under Florida law and the landmark Supreme Court ruling Johnson v. Davis, sellers must disclose all known material facts and defects affecting property value that are not readily observable to the buyer. This includes prior roof leaks, foundation settling, Chinese drywall, unpermitted additions, sinkhole activity, and HOA/CDD liabilities. Failing to execute comprehensive written seller property disclosure forms exposes FSBO sellers to post-closing fraud and misrepresentation lawsuits.
